title: Worldline-Susceptibility Scheduling for Quantum Annealing Beyond Local-Adiabatic Evolution
summary: The performance of quantum annealing depends critically on how the available annealing time is distributed along the evolution. Although the Roland Cerf local adiabatic schedule is theoretically optimal, it requires complete knowledge of the instantaneous spectral gap, making it impractical for large optimization problems. We propose a computationally inexpensive surrogate schedule based on the worldline magnetization susceptibility measured during simulated quantum annealing.
